audience: cleaning companies that run their work with Janitorial Manager

useCases.title: Check open and completed work orders
useCases.text: List the work orders of a period by status. Open one work order to read the full detail.

useCases.title: Review the quality control inspections of a customer
useCases.text: Find a customer, then list the inspections. Open one inspection to read the scores and notes.

useCases.title: Find the hours worked last week
useCases.text: List the time punches of a date range. Read the payroll data to compare the hours of each employee.

useCases.title: Find areas that nobody scanned
useCases.text: List the areas of a location and the area scans of a day. Compare both lists to find the areas without a recorded scan.

useCases.title: Review the supply orders and suppliers
useCases.text: List the supply orders for the sites. Open the supplier of an order to read the details.
